findings.title: Buzzer peak (≈ 96 mA) is six times what a coin cell can pulse
findings.evidence: [estimate: power_budget.py peak check against a 15 mA pulse limit]
findings.fix: Add a 220 µF low-ESR reservoir capacitor and limit ring bursts to 20 ms on / 20 ms off

findings.title: Pessimistic case gives 7 months, not 12
findings.evidence: [estimate: 2× firmware overhead on the bottom-up budget]
findings.fix: Measure on a dev kit; advertise every 3 s instead of 2 s if the measurement is above 18 µA

findings.title: IP67 with a twist lid needs a compressed O-ring and a vented sound port
findings.evidence: [estimate: seal design practice; no prototype yet]
findings.fix: Use a 1.0 mm O-ring at 20–25 % compression and an acoustic membrane on the sound port; test IPX7 on SLA parts

findings.title: Coin-cell product must meet button-battery child-safety rules in the US
findings.fix: Lid needs a tool or two independent motions; warning label on the product and the box
